 Creator Economy Job Radar – November 17, 2026 – Google, Amazon, Twitch, and More
 By Dragomir Stojkov 
 Published on November 17, 2026 
 Creator Economy hiring this week spans platforms, media organizations, consumer brands, and agencies. Following last week’s listings from Lyft, the NFL, and Coach (Tapestry), Google seeks a Global Content Strategy Lead for YouTube Business, Amazon recruits a Brand Partnerships Manager for its creator program, and Twitch lists a Senior Manager for Global Creator Programs. The Washington Post and TikTok USDS Joint Venture add creator roles in strategy, production, and policy advocacy, while Monster Energy, Harry’s, and Roller Rabbit hire across creator marketing, commerce, and community. International listings extend to the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Latin America, with a WPP Media role in Amsterdam and a BBC apprenticeship in Belfast closing the issue.
 BTW, did you know that this week’s Job Radar covers a small selection of the available Creator Economy opportunities? The full Net Influencer Creator Economy job board lists 7,356 open roles across 2,536 companies, filtered by hand and updated every morning. 
 Global Content Strategy Lead, YouTube Business 
 Google, San Bruno, CA / Los Angeles, CA / New York, NY 
 Google seeks a Global Content Strategy Lead to lead a global team of Content Strategists in YouTube’s Scaled Comms & Escalations organization, which creates the materials that help YouTube creators and partners grow. The role involves owning the content strategy roadmap, leading the Brand Deals Education program, and overseeing content creation across Shorts, Live, Podcasts, and Supers.
 Requirements include a bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, 8 years of experience in content strategy, creator or partner education, product marketing, or a related field, 3 years of experience managing people, and experience with the YouTube creator ecosystem, monetization including brand deals, partner management, and Media Cos or the Music Industry.
 Salary range: $186,000-269,000 plus a 20% bonus target, equity, and benefits.
 Brand Partnerships Manager, Creators 
 Amazon, New York, NY 
 Amazon’s Creator Brand Partnerships team seeks a Brand Partnerships Manager to bring brand sponsorships to life across its creator marketing program, including creator events and gifting. The role involves owning direct relationships with brand partners, managing program budgets, deliverables, and sponsored content and talent agreements, and delivering impact reports to partners.
 Requirements include a bachelor’s degree or equivalent, 3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience, and 3+ years in partnership management, account management, or client services, ideally within brand marketing, media, advertising, or entertainment.
 Base salary range: $101,600-177,800 annually, plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units.
 Senior Manager, Global Creator Programs 
 Twitch, San Francisco, CA / Seattle, WA / Irvine, CA / New York, NY 
 Twitch seeks a Senior Manager to own the end-to-end execution of its global scaled creator activation program, which recruits, develops, and retains creators through community-driven programming and milestone-based progression. The role involves building the program’s infrastructure, working with a distributed team of regional community leads, and reporting program performance to senior leadership, with West Coast (PST) working hours.
 Requirements include 6+ years in program management, community operations, or creator/influencer ecosystem roles (or equivalent experience), a track record of building and scaling programs from early stage to thousands of participants, and experience working across distributed teams, including contractors or vendor relationships across multiple regions.
 Salary range: $127,200-185,000 for San Francisco and New York.
 $115,600-160,000 for Seattle and Irvine. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units.
 Creator Advocacy Associate 
 TikTok USDS Joint Venture, Washington, DC (On-site) 
 TikTok USDS Joint Venture seeks a Creator Advocacy Associate for its Public Policy Campaigns and Advocacy team, which brings the experiences of TikTok creators and small businesses to lawmakers and key opinion leaders. The role involves serving as the primary contact for creator advocates, connecting them with federal, state, and local lawmakers at meetings and events, and leading training sessions for lawmakers and staff on using TikTok. The position requires frequent travel around the U.S.
 Requirements include a minimum of 2 years of experience in political campaigns, public policy-focused digital communications, and/or government relations, a working understanding of the current political environment, legislative processes, and the Creator Economy, and a working understanding of the content creation process on TikTok. Experience working with content creators is preferred.
 Salary range: $113,271-187,200 annually, with eligibility for discretionary bonuses or incentives and restricted stock units.
 Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer 
 The Washington Post, New York, United States (On-site) 
 The Washington Post seeks a Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer to support creator-led branded content programs within WP Studios, combining creator partnership strategy with hands-on production. The role involves developing creator partnership strategies, sourcing and vetting creators, negotiating creator fees, and guiding creators through briefing, scripting, and revisions. The position requires on-site work five days a week, with exceptions for newsgathering and business travel.
 Requirements include 5+ years of experience sourcing, evaluating, and developing partnerships with creators for branded content, social media, or digital campaigns, experience guiding creators through content production, and experience negotiating creator or talent fees and managing campaign budgets.
 Salary range: $91,800-153,000 annually, with possible eligibility for a bonus or incentive program.
 Creator and Influencer Director 
 Monster Energy, Corona, CA 
 Monster Energy seeks a Creator and Influencer Director to architect and lead the creator and influencer ecosystem for its Strategic Brands portfolio, which includes Reign, NOS, Bang, Storm, and Full Throttle. The role involves setting creator and Influencer Marketing strategy for all five brands, hiring and leading the creator marketing team, and selecting and managing outside agencies, talent managers, and platforms.
 Requirements include 7+ years of experience in creator, influencer, talent, or earned-media marketing, including owning top-talent relationships, managing agencies, and negotiating contracts, and 7+ years of experience in social media marketing, brand marketing, or communications. A bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field is preferred.
 Pay range: $135,750-181,000 USD.
 Director of Social, Content & Creators 
 Harry’s (Mammoth Brands), New York, NY (Hybrid) 
 Harry’s, a men’s grooming brand, seeks a Director of Social, Content & Creators to lead social media, creator marketing, and sponsored collaborations for the brand. The role involves overseeing strategy for all social channels including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, and leading a team that contracts with creators and agencies to develop and produce content. The position requires working in the office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
 Requirements include 8-10 years of experience making content and managing social and creator campaigns, a proven track record of commissioning or executive producing video content across social channels, and experience setting strategy, driving measurement, and managing small teams.
 Base salary range: $160,000-210,000, plus equity in Mammoth Brands.
 UGC Creator Manager 
 Study.com, Mountain View, CA (Hybrid) 
 Study.com, an online learning platform, seeks a UGC Creator Manager to build the program that sources current and past customers to become creator partners. The role involves defining who the program recruits and how, managing partner production from first contact to first published video, and setting up AI-assisted discovery, vetting, and automated outreach systems. The position requires working in the Mountain View office Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
 Requirements include 2+ years in UGC, creator programs, Influencer Marketing, or social-first growth, including building a program from scratch, hands-on experience building AI and automation workflows, and deep, current fluency in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
 Salary range: $100,000-125,000 per year.
 SVP, Content & Creator – Social Influence and Public Affairs 
 WE Communications, Washington, DC 
 WE Communications, a global communications agency, seeks an SVP, Content & Creator to bring public affairs and reputation expertise together with social and digital experience for client organizations. The role involves leading public affairs strategy, identifying the creators, experts, and advocates who can credibly shape conversation, and building and mentoring multidisciplinary teams spanning public affairs, content strategy, social, creators, and creative.
 Requirements include 15+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, corporate reputation, social strategy, or related disciplines, hands-on experience developing social and digital strategy, and experience counseling senior executives and C-suite leaders.
 Salary range: $195,000-234,000 USD, with a benefits program that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage.
 Creator and Social Media Strategy Manager 
 American Chemical Society, Washington, DC (Hybrid) 
 The American Chemical Society, a nonprofit membership organization, seeks a Creator and Social Media Strategy Manager to build and scale its social media strategy. The role involves developing a content creator partnership roadmap with frameworks for identifying and engaging creators, leading a team of social media specialists, and providing strategic leadership across platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and Bluesky. Employees work onsite two days per week.
 Requirements include 9+ years of experience in social media strategy or related fields, 5+ years of experience managing teams in a complex or matrixed environment and advising executives on social media best practices, and fluency with social analytics, social listening, and media monitoring tools.
 Salary range: $125,000-140,000 per year, plus benefits including health insurance and retirement benefits.
 Digital Agent – Creators Department (NY & LA) 
 Innovative Artists, Santa Monica, CA 
 Innovative Artists, a full-service talent agency based in LA and NYC, seeks a Digital Agent for its Creators Department to work directly with content creators, influencers, and digital talent. The role involves assisting in managing digital-first talent across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Twitch, coordinating brand partnerships and digital campaigns, and tracking campaign performance. The agency seeks agents with experience in the beauty, lifestyle, culinary, and gaming spaces.
 Requirements include 2+ years of experience in digital media or talent representation, strong client relationships with influencers, creators, podcasters, and streamers, and a deep understanding of major social media platforms and content trends.
 Salary range: $80,000-200,000 per year.
 Account Executive, Digital/Influencer 
 AZIONE, New York, NY (Hybrid) 
 AZIONE, a creative communications agency founded in 2010, seeks an Account Executive, Digital/Influencer to support clients across its Beauty, Lifestyle, Wellness, and CPG portfolio. The role involves serving as a day-to-day client contact, developing and executing strategic seeding and gifting programs, and managing talent outreach, negotiations, and contracting for earned and paid influencer campaigns.
 Requirements include 2+ years of post-graduate agency experience with a meaningful focus on Influencer Marketing, celebrity/VIP relations, and talent partnerships, demonstrated experience executing earned and paid influencer campaigns, and a growing network across influencers, creators, celebrities, stylists, publicists, agents, and managers.
 Salary range: $75,000-80,000 annually, with 100% medical and dental coverage, bonus and commission opportunities, and 401(k) benefits.
 Creator Commerce & Community Manager 
 Roller Rabbit, New York, NY (Hybrid) 
 Roller Rabbit seeks a Creator Commerce & Community Manager to own and grow its ambassador and creator commerce programs. The role involves managing the ambassador program, including college and community ambassadors, running grassroots ambassador activations, managing creator commerce initiatives including ShopMy, and reviewing the PR inbox for creator and partnership opportunities. The position requires three days per week in the office.
 Requirements include 3-5 years of experience in Influencer Marketing, creator partnerships, affiliate/creator commerce, community marketing, experiential marketing, PR, or a related field, and a strong understanding of the creator landscape and platforms including TikTok, Instagram, and ShopMy.
 Salary range: $75,000-100,000 per year, with benefits including unlimited PTO and a company discount and allowance.
 Director of Influencer Partnerships 
 Matter, New York, NY 
 Matter, a nutrition platform that pairs personalized nutrition intelligence with tailored meals, seeks a Director of Influencer Partnerships to build its influencer and creator program from the ground up. The role involves developing a tiered creator strategy across fitness, nutrition, and wellness, sourcing and negotiating with creators and talent managers, and measuring creator ROI by CAC, conversion, and retention.
 Requirements include 3+ years in Influencer Marketing or creator partnerships, with a track record of building a program from the ground up at a high-growth consumer brand, existing relationships in fitness, nutrition, or wellness, and experience using macro tracking apps.
 Salary range: $100,000-135,000 base, plus equity.
 Talent Manager (Creator Partnerships) 
 Arcade, London, UK 
 Arcade, an entertainment company that builds Europe’s biggest creators into media brands, seeks a Talent Manager to run a high volume of brand partnerships across its creator roster, from first conversation to final invoice. The role involves negotiating fees, usage, and exclusivity, leading gifting, events, and PR moments, and building a network of brands and agencies. The position carries a personal revenue target.
 Requirements include a track record of negotiating and closing creator partnerships or brand deals in talent management, a creator or influencer agency, or a creator-led business, existing relationships with influencer agencies, brands, and talent managers, and an understanding of creators and platforms across entertainment, sport, and gaming.
 Salary range: £45,000-50,000 per year.
 E-Commerce Specialist (TikTok Shop) 
 SBT Global, Inc., Costa Mesa, CA (On-site) 
 SBT Global seeks an E-Commerce Specialist to own and scale its TikTok Shop business, driving GMV growth and managing account health and compliance. The role involves owning affiliate strategy, managing the TikTok Shop agency and external partners, collaborating with the Influencer Marketing team, and planning promotions, inventory, and fulfillment coordination with a 3PL.
 Requirements include 3+ years of experience in e-commerce or marketplace account management and fluency in both Korean and English. Direct TikTok Shop experience and experience in the beauty, skincare, or cosmetics industry are preferred.
 Salary range: $70,000-75,000 per year.
 Content Creator 
 Fello, Linthicum Heights, MD 
 Fello, a nonprofit that partners with people with disabilities to provide support services and develop inclusive housing, seeks a Content Creator to develop content supporting its marketing and fundraising efforts across social media and other communications channels. The role involves creating photography, video, graphics, and written content with a focus on short-form, platform-specific content, developing recurring content series, and providing real-time event coverage. The position is eligible for moderate telework.
 Requirements include a bachelor’s degree in English, communications, marketing, or a related field and three years of experience leading strategy and creating social media brand content. A master’s degree is a plus.
 Salary: $80,000 per year, plus a Total Rewards benefits package.
 UGC Coordinator 
 Elavate, Remote (Latin America) 
 Elavate, a multi-collagen supplement brand for women 40+, seeks a UGC Coordinator to source and sign creators across the UK and U.S., brief and storyboard scripts, and coordinate influencer and high-production shoots. The role involves building and running a creator database, negotiating rates and usage and whitelisting terms, and checking every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming. The contractor position requires core hours that overlap the UK afternoon and the U.S. working day.
 Requirements include 2+ years in UGC, creator, or influencer coordination at a DTC brand, a UGC or performance creative agency, or an influencer or talent agency, fluent written and spoken English, and experience with performance marketing metrics, Motion or a similar tool, Frame.io, and Notion.
 Salary: $30,000 USD per year (about $2,500 a month) as an independent contractor, with a 3-month review against clear goals and 28 days of paid time off.
 Junior Influencer Marketing Project Manager 
 WPP Media/StudioM, Amsterdam, The Netherlands (Hybrid) 
 WPP Media, a subsidiary of WPP, seeks a Junior Influencer Marketing Project Manager for StudioM, its in-house agency responsible for Influencer Marketing campaigns launched on a large international scale. The role involves helping develop influencer campaign strategies, identifying and evaluating influencers, briefing influencers and monitoring deadlines, and reporting on campaign progress. Campaigns span the Netherlands and Western Europe.
 Requirements include at least 1 year of demonstrable work experience in Influencer Marketing and social media, excellent organizational and time management skills, and a very good command of both Dutch and English.
 Salary range: €2,700-3,400, based on 38.75 hours per week.
 Content Creator Apprenticeship – Level 3 – BBC Introducing 
 BBC, Belfast, UK 
 The BBC seeks apprentices for its Level 3 Content Creator Apprenticeship with BBC Introducing, a 15-month fixed-term, full-time program. The role involves researching, writing, producing, and editing content, creating content for social media platforms, and working with BBC Radio Ulster’s Music and Entertainment teams on daily radio output, events, and digital content while studying toward a Level 3 Content Creator qualification. Applications close November 24, 2026.
 Requirements include being 18 or older by the apprenticeship start in September 2027, having lived in the UK continuously for the last three years, and being legally eligible to work full-time in the UK. No prior learning is required, and the scheme is aimed at non-graduates.
 Salary: £24,650.
